campaigns.goal: Create advice-first conversations that can become demos, referrals, or meetings.
campaigns.message_angle: Local Brentwood high schooler building The Call Taker asks whether missed-call and after-hours capture is a real pain.
personalization_rules: use first name only if source-backed
no first-touch pricing or checkout link
autonomous_actions_allowed: send if Instagram adapter connected and limits pass

follow_up_sequence.rule: final polite close or park; no pressure

campaigns.next_agent_action: Middle Revenue Agent can research real local accounts, generate policy-checked DMs, and send if Instagram adapter is connected.

segment_playbooks.first_message:
Saw your roofing work around the area - roofers seem like one of those businesses where missed calls can turn into missed jobs fast.

Hey {first_name}, I'm Wallace, local in Brentwood and a high schooler building The Call Taker, an AI receptionist for local businesses.

It answers calls, captures customer info, and helps owners avoid losing jobs when they can't pick up.

I have my first customer now, but I'm trying to learn how to get from one customer to more. If you were in my shoes, what would you do? Any advice would help a lot.
segment_playbooks.follow_up_1: Quick follow-up, no pressure. For roofing, do missed calls ever turn into lost jobs, or is that not the problem I should focus on?
segment_playbooks.follow_up_2: I'll leave this alone after this. If you ever have one quick thought on how to explain missed-call capture without sounding salesy, it would help.
segment_playbooks.if_gives_advice: Reply with a specific thank-you, summarize the advice, ask one follow-up about explaining missed-call value.
segment_playbooks.if_asks_what_it_does: Autonomous reply allowed: explain call answering, info capture, and owner handoff.
segment_playbooks.if_asks_website: Autonomous reply allowed: send https://thecalltaker.com with honest early-stage context.
segment_playbooks.if_asks_pricing: Autonomous reply allowed only for standard $97/$497/$997+ facts; custom terms escalate.
segment_playbooks.if_sounds_interesting: Autonomous reply allowed: offer demo line or 30-second explanation.
segment_playbooks.if_not_interested: Autonomous polite close-out and suppress lead.
